doc_title_en: Notice of Dividend Payment (First Post-Listing Dividend) and Dividend Policy
doc_title_jp: 剰余金の配当（上場後初配）及び配当方針に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 上場後初配当。業績上方修正達成に基づき実施

summary_en: First post-IPO dividend of 76 yen/share approved for FY4/26 (ended April 2026), reflecting 18.0% payout ratio on net income of ¥1,310M. Policy commits to continued stable dividend growth with target payout ratio to be raised progressively. FY5/27 dividend also set at 76 yen/share (20.6% payout ratio forecast).
summary_jp: 上場後初配当 76円/株を FY4/26 に承認。配当性向18.0%、当期純利益 ¥1,310M に基づく。継続的で安定した配当成長を方針とし、配当性向段階的引上げ予定。FY5/27 も 76円/株（配当性向20.6%見込み）。
tag_en: Dividend Policy - First post-IPO dividend 76 yen/share (18.0% payout ratio) - FY4/26
